messages:
tom: Quick alert \/ running int8 candidate (q3-cpu-int8) through the OCR->translate vertical pipeline. Seeing spurious '[UNK_LINE]' tokens and sentence shuffling around hard line breaks in Han vertical samples. BLEU down ~6.5 pts on the vertical hk-dev split.

aya: Can you drop a tiny repro and the exact BLEU diff?

tom: Repro (compare fp16 baseline -> q3-cpu-int8):
```\ninput:
"第1行。\n第2行。\n第3行。"
baseline: "Line one. Line two. Line three."
q3-int8: "Line one. [UNK_LINE] Line two. Line three."
```
BLEU: baseline 33.2 -> q3 26.7 (hk-vertical-ocr-dev, n=1800). EM drop ~15%.

leo: That inserted marker is the placeholder our detok uses when the tokenizer emits an unexpected U+2063 or U+200B near merges. Any detok logs?

tom: Tokenizer dump from the failing sample shows ids: [342, 0x200B, 1267] only on int8 path. Raw bytes near break: e4 b8 80 0a e4 b8 81.

sara: Could be nondeterminism in the merge loop after switching to the int8 fused merge kernel. Did you try forcing the scalar/reference merge?

tom: I ran a quick A/B: reference merge (force-merge-ref) -> no hallucination, BLEU back to 31.9. Fused int8 kernel triggers the placeholder.

canary-bot: Canary failed: q3-cpu-int8 (canary-12) detok-check FAILED (delta BLEU -6.5). Automatic rollback scheduled.

aya: Good catch. Next steps: leo to bisect the int8 merge kernel changes (especially the path that inserts soft-break markers), infra to add a minimal detok roundtrip test for vertical CJK samples, and tom to collect the top 20 failing examples and attach to the bug.

leo: Will bisect today. I suspect the caching layer in the fused kernel mis-handles zero-width markers when chunking; will add assert and a deterministic merged-sequence unit test.

tom: Uploaded 20 examples to the issue and linked canary logs + tokenizer traces. Repro harness: `python tests/repro/hk_vertical_repro.py --image=q3-cpu-int8`.

aya: Also let's gate the canary with the detok smoke (roundtrip) before allowing fused-int8 kernel selection. For short term, keep rollback and make fused kernel opt-in.

leo: I'll open PR with the opt-in flag + unit test. If test passes, we can try a restricted canary.

tom: tl;dr: int8 fused merge kernel causes detok placeholder when encountering certain linebreak-adjacent codepoints in vertical Han OCR inputs; reference merge avoids it. Mitigation: opt-out fused kernel until fix + deterministic unit tests + bisect.
